Lydia Morton: Quick kickoff for a three-cloud listing + hardware partner (ForgeEdge). Need owners on: final EULA, co-branded hero, AMI/GCP/managed-image + OVA, appliance compatibility matrix, SKU/pricing rows, trial entitlement caps, SI integration blurb, and launch embargo timing.

Owen Park: Ill take images (AWS AMIs x86 & arm64, GCP custom images, Azure managed image). Need staging publisher IDs and any acceptance test tokens. Will include cloud-init that writes /etc/marketplace-validate.

Sofia Alvarez: Marketing: I can supply co-branded heroes (desktop, mobile, tile). Need legal-signed logo release and the partner-approved copy. Target assets by Thu.

Ben Cho: Legal: EULA draft ready, but require incident contact + escalation email for the listing. Also confirm wording for ForgeEdge: use "listed with ForgeEdge integration" not "joint offering". Need product to confirm trial caps.

Lydia Morton: Publisher refs for staging (confirm infra): AWS acct 555666777888, GCP project redwood-market-stg-2, Azure publisher redwood-csp-stg-2. Owen, DM infra for the test token. Example AMI name: `redwood-inference-ami-ubuntu22-<region>-<arch>-forgeedge-2026-06`.

Owen Park: Copy. ETA: AMIs Tue EOD, GCP images Wed, Azure managed image Thu AM. Ill post image IDs + SHA256 checksums. Adding small smoke script: `curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1` and create `/etc/marketplace-validate` with the token.

Sofia Alvarez: For announcement/embargo: ForgeEdge requests a coordinated press window. Proposed listing live date 2026-06-20, submission target 2026-06-11. Thoughts?

Ben Cho: That timeline works. Legal will attach EULA PDF and logo release once marketing gets signatures. Also adding KMS blurb: "Customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated, Private, and Appliance SKUs; hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys."

Owen Park: Note for appliance OVA: ForgeEdge needs an installer hook that validates the license key and hardware SKU. Ill include `/usr/local/bin/forge-validate.sh` that checks CPU vendor and disk size.

Sofia Alvarez: Co-branding: ForgeEdge wants their logo on the tile and a short partner quote (one sentence). Ill loop in their partner manager for approval.

Ben Cho: Privacy/telemetry line for listing: "We collect anonymized operational metrics to improve reliability; no PII is exported. Customers may opt-out for Dedicated/Private deployments." OK?

Lydia Morton: SKU plan: RedwoodInference-API (hosted), RedwoodInference-Dedicated, RedwoodInference-Appliance-ForgeEdge. Pricing: hourly + monthly commit tiers. Trial: 30 days, 60k token cap, 12 rps. Product confirm quotas?

Owen Park: Also include marketplace acceptance test: file `/etc/marketplace-validate` must contain `forge-rsw-3412` and `/health` must return 200 within 2s for smoke. I'll bake that in.

Sofia Alvarez: Will prepare hero assets by Thu and upload signed release. Ill draft announcement copy aligned with embargo date.

Ben Cho: Uploading EULA + trademark release to the intake ticket after sign-off. Also recommend short support SLA snippet: "24h initial response for Sev1, 72h for Sev2; see support matrix."

MarketplaceBot: Created ticket MP-6710: "marketplace intake - redwood inference (ForgeEdge)" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-6710

Lydia Morton: Action items: Owen = images + checksums + validation artifacts, Sofia = hero assets + partner quote, Ben = EULA + logo release + support SLA, Lydia = pricing rows + intake submission. Target portal submit 2026-06-11 COB.

Sofia Alvarez: + looping in ForgeEdge PM now.

Ben Cho: + will push legal artifacts to MP-6710 when ready.
